task_name: World 116 Task A  -  Medical Device CMO LHR-to-Invoice Quantity, Testing Add-On & Sub-Lot Material Reconciliation
prompt: Perform a comprehensive Accounting & CFO Close review using the world files (`cmo_lhr_invoicing_and_qc_archive_audit_2026.xlsx`). Identify all accounting, reconciliation, cutoff, or operational variances; state the exact dollar figures, percentages, and transaction/journal/work-order IDs; propose any required correcting journal entries (with exact Debit and Credit accounts); and enforce all close certification guardrails.

rubric.description: Reconciles Lot 011926B (NeuroVasc Corp): 17 FG units at $285.00 ($4,845.00) plus paper-only LHR testing pulls of 3 LAL samples at $145.00 ($435.00) and 2 LotRT samples at $210.00 ($420.00) for a true billable total of $5,700.00, catching an $855.00 (15.00%) ERP under-billing variance.

Reconciles Lot 070826H (VentricFlow Inc): 24 Good FG units at $310.00 ($7,440.00), 3 Scrap units on a mandatory $0.00-rate line (27 total build units), plus $1,323.00 of billable CMO-supplied sub-lot materials (RJ-45110-1 54 units at $18.50 = $999.00 and RJ-45110-2 27 units at $12.00 = $324.00) while excluding $1,215.00 of customer-consigned CMP-99012 hubs, for a total invoice of $8,763.00.

Reconciles Lot 031826A (SinglePass Med) across base LHR and Rework PD 157: 18 initial good FG + 1 rework-recovered FG = 19 net billable FG units at $260.00 ($4,940.00) and 1 final scrap unit, catching a -$260.00 over-billing adjustment versus the 20-unit ($5,200.00) unadjusted ERP draft.

Enforces the CMO source-packet governance rule: never certify or release a customer invoice from ERP headline quantities alone without pinning the SHA-256 LHR/CoC packet, reading sibling sub-lot material packets (RJ-45110-1/2), and reconciling companion Rework/PD packets.
